property.text: verify_data_column_sidecar MUST reject any sidecar where len(column) != len(kzg_commitments) or len(column) != len(kzg_proofs). All three arrays MUST have equal length.

reachability.notes: Attacker can craft sidecar with mismatched array lengths.

property.severity_justification: Mismatched lengths could cause out-of-bounds access during KZG proof verification, crashing the node.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing mismatched-length sidecar bypassing validation.

property.text: All cells in a column MUST share the same cell index, equal to the column index. verify_data_column_sidecar_kzg_proofs MUST construct cell_indices = [CellIndex(sidecar.index)] * len(sidecar.column).

reachability.notes: Incorrect cell index assignment would cause KZG verification to pass for data at wrong positions.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect cell index mapping would break the data availability guarantee, allowing invalid data to pass verification.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires demonstrating cell index mismatch causing false KZG proof acceptance.

property.text: verify_cell_kzg_proof_batch MUST receive consistent-length arrays: len(commitments_bytes) == len(cell_indices) == len(cells) == len(proofs_bytes).

reachability.notes: Inconsistent array lengths passed to KZG library could cause undefined behavior.

property.severity_justification: Inconsistent lengths in KZG batch verification could cause crashes or bypass verification.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing inconsistent array lengths reaching KZG library.

property.text: KZG_COMMITMENTS_INCLUSION_PROOF_DEPTH MUST equal 4. The Merkle proof linking kzg_commitments to body_root MUST use exactly this depth.

reachability.notes: Incorrect proof depth would cause all inclusion proofs to fail or accept invalid proofs.

property.severity_justification: Wrong proof depth would cause valid sidecars to be rejected (liveness failure) or invalid sidecars accepted (safety failure).
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires demonstrating proof depth mismatch causing acceptance of forged sidecar.

property.text: The Merkle inclusion proof MUST correctly link hash_tree_root(sidecar.kzg_commitments) to the BeaconBlockBody root via the blob_kzg_commitments field's generalized index.

reachability.notes: Attacker could craft sidecar with forged inclusion proof.

property.severity_justification: Accepting sidecar with invalid inclusion proof breaks data availability integrity.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing forged inclusion proof bypassing is_valid_merkle_branch.

property.text: compute_subnet_for_data_column_sidecar MUST return a value in range [0, DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT) for all valid column_index values. DATA_COLUMN_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT == 128.

reachability.notes: Subnet miscalculation would fragment the gossip network.

property.severity_justification: Incorrect subnet computation causes sidecars to be published to wrong subnets, fragmenting data availability.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires demonstrating subnet routing error causing data availability failure.

property.text: In the data_column_sidecar gossip validation pipeline, ALL REJECT checks MUST fail (i.e., return non-REJECT results) before a message is accepted and forwarded to peers.

reachability.notes: An attacker sends crafted sidecars via gossip. Any bypass of a REJECT check is a critical vulnerability.

property.severity_justification: Bypassing any REJECT check allows invalid sidecars to propagate across the network, potentially corrupting data availability.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing a sidecar that bypasses one or more REJECT validation steps.

property.text: IGNORE conditions in gossip validation MUST allow re-processing of the sidecar later (via queuing). An IGNORED sidecar MUST NOT be permanently discarded or forwarded.

reachability.notes: Incorrect IGNORE handling could cause data loss (permanent discard) or amplification (forwarding).

property.severity_justification: Permanently discarding IGNORED sidecars degrades data availability. Forwarding them bypasses validation.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing IGNORED sidecar being forwarded without re-validation.

property.text: Exactly one path from q_init to q_final MUST be taken per sidecar during gossip validation. The validation pipeline MUST be deterministic and non-branching (only one outcome per sidecar).

reachability.notes: Non-deterministic validation would cause different nodes to reach different conclusions about the same sidecar.

property.severity_justification: Non-deterministic validation causes consensus divergence between nodes.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires demonstrating non-deterministic validation outcome for identical sidecar.

property.text: The deduplication key for data column sidecars MUST be the tuple (slot, proposer_index, sidecar.index). Only the first valid sidecar for each unique tuple MUST be accepted; subsequent duplicates MUST be IGNORED.

reachability.notes: An attacker (equivocating proposer) sends conflicting sidecars for the same tuple.

property.severity_justification: Accepting conflicting sidecars for the same tuple allows equivocation, breaking data availability consistency.
property.bug_bounty_notes: Requires PoC showing duplicate or conflicting sidecar acceptance for same dedup key.
